name: Flux One
full_name: Flux One mobile magnetic navigation system
group: Flux Robotics B.V. (University of Twente spin-off; Heunis, Misra)
versions: Flux One: KUKA LBR iiwa with a liquid-cooled electromagnetic coil on a mobile trolley (heunis2023_flux Sec. II-B, Fig. 4); later system on a Doosan arm in the company photo (twente_fluxrobotics, article names 'Flux 2, the latest version'); described as a prototype of ARMM (utwente2023_flux; see armm_heunis2020)
target_anatomy: fenestrated EVAR: coeliac artery and branches, SMA, left renal and contralateral common iliac arteries of an abdominal phantom (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-B)
devices_driven: magnetic J-tip guidewire: Terumo Radifocus 0.032-in (0.81 mm) with a 10 mm tip of five NdFeB magnets, 2 mm diameter, silicone coated (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-A)
n_dof_detail: 7 (arm and coil) + surgeon push-pull 1, guidewire bent in two planes (heunis2023_flux Sec. IV-C)
translation_detail: magnetic (tip steering); insertion by the surgeon's hand at the bedside (heunis2023_flux Sec. I, IV-C)
rotation_detail: coil pose (7-DoF arm) and coil current set field strength and direction (heunis2023_flux Sec. I-II)
device_range: tip deflection -135 to 135 deg planned (heunis2023_flux Sec. II-A)
force_sensing: none on the guidewire; arm keeps a 4 N virtual interaction-force constraint (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-A)
haptics_leader: Omega.6 haptic device for coil positioning with force feedback at a virtual safety barrier, plus SpaceMouse, push buttons and touchscreen (heunis2023_flux Sec. II-B, Fig. 4e)
imaging_compat: pre-operative cone-beam CT planning and live fluoroscopy in a hybrid OR (Siemens Artis Pheno); no CT artefacts per Siemens technician (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-B)
validation_detail: silicone abdominal phantom from patient CT, 4 targets: one vascular surgeon with conventional (case 1) and magnetic (case 2) guidewire, 11 novice operators with Flux One; all targets reached, no adverse events (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-B, IV-A, IV-C). Company reports preclinical animal trials and first tests in Miami (twente_fluxrobotics), no published result
key_numbers: coil field up to 60 mT (heunis2023_flux Sec. I, citing its ref. 18); guidewire navigation time -47%; target 4: 22.7 s vs 73 s (-69%); 11-37 s per target in case 2; mean SUS 80%; coil cooling 9.2 L/min keeps surface at 45 C; arm speed limit 0.02 m/s (heunis2023_flux Sec. III-IV)
sim_model: virtual clone of the system for trajectory planning (Policy Improvement with Path Integrals), no guidewire physics simulator (heunis2023_flux Sec. II-C)
